document_title: Process Characterization Master Report — A-Mab Drug Substance
schema_note: Blocks validate against nlp_reports app/models; parameter_type, document_type, QualityAttribute criticality fields, StudyDesign and DesignSpace are local extensions (see schema_extensions_used).
out_of_schema_notes: Master report rolls up the per-unit-operation reports; entities are the Step 3-10 process steps and the consolidated CQA outcomes.
Parameter classification is reported as counts (1 CPP / 20 WC-CPP / 10 KPP / 6 GPP); individual parameter names are in the per-UO reports, not restated here.
Process-capability (min Cpk 1.51) and cumulative viral clearance (18.87 / 10.03) are report_sections statements (no dedicated field).

inventory.rationale: Title block declares document class 'Process Characterization Master Report'.

process_steps.description: Forms the glycan, charge-variant and aggregate CQAs (design-space step)
Primary recovery and clarification; forms no product-quality CQA
Capture; sets leached Protein A; principal HCP and DNA clearance
Low-pH hold; sets the cumulative XMuLV (enveloped) clearance
Polish; principal aggregate reduction; major HCP/DNA/leached-PA clearance
Flow-through polish; sets the cumulative MVM clearance; clears XMuLV/HCP/DNA
Dedicated small-virus removal; principal MVM clearance
Formulation / mass balance; delivers drug substance at target concentration

statements.statement_text: PCMR-001 consolidates the Stage 1 characterization of the A-Mab drug-substance process, rolling up the per-unit-operation reports.
All 37 process parameters were classified: 1 CPP, 20 WC-CPP, 10 KPP and 6 GPP.
All 10 drug-substance CQAs meet their acceptance criteria at commercial scale with Cpk >= 1.51.

source_references.quote: meet their acceptance criteria at commercial scale

statements.statement_text: The modular viral clearance meets its requirements with margin (18.87 / 10.03 log10 for XMuLV / MVM).

source_references.quote: modular viral clearance meets its requirements with margin

statements.statement_text: The integrated process delivers an overall drug-substance yield of 83.2% (~54.6 kg).
The process is ready for Stage 2 (Process Performance Qualification).

assertions.assertion_text: The A-Mab drug-substance process has the step Production Bioreactor.
The A-Mab drug-substance process has the step Harvest and Clarification.
The A-Mab drug-substance process has the step Protein A Chromatography.
The A-Mab drug-substance process has the step Low-pH Viral Inactivation.
The A-Mab drug-substance process has the step Cation Exchange Chromatography.
The A-Mab drug-substance process has the step Anion Exchange Chromatography.
The A-Mab drug-substance process has the step Small-Virus Retentive Filtration.
The A-Mab drug-substance process has the step Ultrafiltration / Diafiltration.
The production bioreactor forms and controls the glycan CQAs within its design space.

source_references.quote: formed and controlled in the production bioreactor

assertions.assertion_text: Cation exchange polishes the aggregate CQA.
Viral clearance is delivered orthogonally across the low-pH inactivation, anion-exchange and virus-filtration steps.
